The ground in Anmore Homes for Sale

items.t: Fee-simple is the verified form: A fee-simple Anmore parcel carries no strata, no Form B and no strata fees — title, Village rules and any registered covenants govern.
Lot fabric, only: large-lot semi-rural parcels in a forested setting with limited routes in and out.

blocks.text: Streets, schools and getting around Anmore Homes for Sale

items.t: Municipal identity: the Village of Anmore runs its own municipal office (Anmore Community Hub, 2697 Sunnyside Road, Anmore, BC V3H 5G9) and its own bylaws, council and services site at anmore.com — village rules, not Port Moody rules, govern an Anmore parcel.
Board geography, with its caveat: for board statistics Anmore is a sub-area inside the Port Moody community grouping (which also groups Belcarra and Port Moody proper).

Setting and access: the Village describes a rural setting surrounded by forests, with a limited number of routes in and out of the community that are also used by visitors travelling to recreation areas such as Buntzen Lake.

Buntzen Lake: parking and access are managed by BC Hydro, including BC Hydro's reservation system and lot capacity, while the Village enforces its own parking and traffic bylaws on surrounding streets — parking is not permitted on restricted streets, including areas on or near Sunnyside Road by Buntzen Lake.

faq.q: Is an Anmore acreage fee-simple or strata?
faq.a: Fee-simple is the verified default for the village's acreage/estate stock.

faq.q: Can an Anmore acreage be subdivided?
faq.a: Subdivision and servicing run through the Village; confirm the requirement for the specific parcel there.

Yes. Anmore is the Village of Anmore, a village municipality in Metro Vancouver with its own council, bylaws and municipal office at 2697 Sunnyside Road; its board statistics, however, are grouped inside the Port Moody SnapStats community (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats).

Two SD43 schools are physically located in the village: Anmore Elementary (30 Elementary Rd, Anmore) and Eagle Mountain Middle School (110 Dogwood Dr, Anmore), checked against the BC Ministry K-12 schools file used by this program. Catchment for a specific home is address-based and must be confirmed in the SD43 locator — no Anmore locator run is on record in this program (~/workspace/area-research-2026-11/education/work/bc_k12_schools.csv, read 2026-11-01).

faq.q: How active is the Anmore market?
faq.a: Thin and slow-turning in the most recent month in the data: the Anmore sub-area showed 28 detached listings with 0 solds in September 2026, and no Condos & Townhomes listings at all — inside a Port Moody community that recorded 15 detached and 29 attached solds the same month (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats).
